description: A line with only one position channel, and that channel not the one its orientation makes its dimension. `getSort` asks whether the dimension channel is a *field* before ordering the points by it: there is an order to draw them in only where the dimension is a column. This compiler ordered by the channel name regardless, so Vega was handed `sort: {"field": "y"}` for items with no `y` — every item comparing equal, a sort that does nothing at some cost. Found by probing a layer of such a mark, and it has nothing to do with layers.
